_readme: REAL (non-template) manifest for lightweight ORIGINAL in-repo SVG placeholders only. These are self-attested original work authored in this repo (no third-party asset, no AI-generated asset, no external licence claim). 'status: approved' on each asset means 'approved as an original project-owned placeholder by its author', NOT the named human art-owner rights sign-off of docs/art-pipeline/README.md section 8. D-002/D-012/D-018 remain UNRESOLVED at the owner level; a human must still sign off before these are treated as a rights-cleared asset pack or integrated at runtime. Checksums and sizes are the real committed-file values. Nothing here is downloaded, ingested or approved by tooling.
styleDecision: Provisional only - D-002 final style decision pending named owner sign-off (see docs/ART_DIRECTION.md draft).
rightsDecision: Original in-repo work with no third-party rights; D-012 policy sign-off still pending named owner.
licenseDecision: CC0/project-owned applies to these original placeholders only; D-018 repo/content licence decision still pending named owner.
note: Lightweight original SVG placeholders created in-repo for THE BAR prototype. No external assets commissioned, downloaded, imported or approved. Runtime still uses the vector-only SceneArt.tsx placeholders; these files are reference/originals awaiting the human approval workflow in section 8.
